findings: The preview uses retained base (boostable minus terrain) for food.
At retained base <=20000 it adds Rationing and Light Rationing reductions; above the threshold it applies only Rationing.
Food is retained base times efficiency times one plus applicable reductions times 0.01, rounded to two decimals.
Runi overrides regional efficiency to one.
Castle/Keep preview food is zero; their tax model is not implemented by this estimator.
scope: Public client preview inspection; no live backend comparison. Per-worker preview resource output is rounded to three decimals before summing.
